title: ACEA: An Adversarial Co-Evolution Arena for Head-to-Head Red-Team and Blue-Team LLM Testing
abstract: arXiv:2609.08256v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated red-team attacks and blue-team defenses for large language models (LLMs) are advancing quickly. However, attackers and defenders are built and tested in isolation, and the resulting scores are hard to trust. To tackle this, we present ACEA (Adversarial Co-Evolution Arena), a platform that connects a pluggable red-team adapter and a pluggable blue-team adapter to a shared target LLM and scores their attack and defense rates with an LLM judge. ACEA contributes four components. First, a pluggable, model-agnostic arena. Any red or blue project connects over a minimal HTTP protocol, which we call the ACEA Standard Adapter Protocol (ASAP). It can be written in any language, and a project that exposes nothing but the protocol is a full participant. Second, an evaluation methodology built for adversarial rounds. translated_title: ACEA：用于红队与蓝队大语言模型正面对抗测试的对抗协同进化竞技场
translated_abstract: 针对大语言模型（LLM）的自动化红队攻击和蓝队防御正在快速发展。然而，攻击者和防御者是在相互隔离的环境中构建和测试的，因此所得到的评分结果难以令人信服。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 ACEA（对抗协同进化竞技场），这是一个将可插拔的红队适配器和可插拔的蓝队适配器连接到共享目标 LLM 的平台，并使用 LLM 评判器对其攻击成功率和防御成功率进行评分。ACEA 贡献了四个组件。第一，一个可插拔的、与模型无关的竞技场。任何红队或蓝队项目都可以通过一个极简的 HTTP 协议（我们称之为 ACEA 标准适配器协议，ASAP）接入。该协议可以用任何编程语言实现，一个仅需暴露该协议的项目即可成为完整的参与者。第二，一种专为对抗回合设计的评估方法。通过在目标模型中植入规范化的密钥，可以获得可验证的真实基准，从而将真实的密钥泄露与模型幻觉区分开来。（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了ACEA对抗协同进化竞技场平台，通过标准化协议将红队攻击方与蓝队防御方连接到共享目标大语言模型进行正面攻防对抗评估，解决了攻防工具孤立构建测试导致的评分不可信问题。
en_tdlr: ACEA is a pluggable, model-agnostic co-evolution arena that connects red-team attackers and blue-team defenders head-to-head against a shared target LLM, enabling trustworthy adversarial evaluation of LLM safety through standardized protocols and verifiable secret-seeding ground truth.
